name: CHRONO Align
motto: Map timing to windows. Claim no outcomes.
function: Maps observed CHRONO_SCAN timing metrics to bounded candidate execution windows without escalating to outcome certainty or Forecast influence.
constraints: No lawful window yields null fields (no improvisation)
Deterministic: identical observed_temporal_metrics + candidate_actions ordering + alignment_policy yield identical inferred windows
canonical_statement: RUNE.CHRONO_ALIGN (CHA) maps observed CHRONO_SCAN timing metrics to bounded candidate windows and emits null-safe inferred fields with NOT_COMPUTABLE flags when no lawful window exists. It does not claim action success, convert alignment into certainty, import symbolic overlays as evidence, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: Given identical observed_temporal_metrics + identical candidate_actions ordering + identical alignment_policy, inferred windows must be identical.

inputs.name: observed_temporal_metrics
inputs.type: { cadence_interval: number | null; recurrence_strength: number | null; window_density: number | null; timing_volatility: number | null; cadence_stability: number | null; recurrence_pressure: number | null }

inputs.name: alignment_policy
inputs.type: { min_confidence: number | null; max_window_span: string | null }

outputs.name: inferred
outputs.type: { alignment_window: string | null; execution_readiness: string | null; timing_advantage_hypothesis: string | null; window_decay_rate: number | null; not_computable_flags?: string[] }
